The research found that the method Support Vector Regression has better performance than Long Short-Term Memory method for making a prediction of the number Covid-19 using Machine Learning model based on the value of accuracy and error rate based with the value of R-Squared, MAE, and MSE are consecutively 0.902, 0.163, and 0.072.

articleTitle: Overview of the Integration Between Electric Vehicles and Smart Grid Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This paper presents a large-scale study and evaluation of the most recent discoveries and advances of electric vehicle communication with a brilliant grid technology describing a future electric powertrain model. The goal of the smart matrix along with future electric vehicle layouts addresses various challenges related to the platform, suitability and control of the electrical system. After a survey focusing on advanced measurement and matching frameworks, the methodology of electric vehicles in the grid is introduced. Other nifty advances in electric vehicle charging are also extensively analyzed in terms of their potential capabilities, effects and limitations in grid-connected vehicle conditions. In addition, the strong penetration of sustainable energy sources (wind and solar photovoltaic) is creating momentum as part of the force. Their discontinuous performance of force causes many difficulties in the organization, operation and control of force organizations. Again, the placement of electric vehicles in the energy market can compensate for changes in the power grid. In these particular cases, a written assessment of the most recent possible and environmentally friendly energy regulation using electric vehicles with knowledge of promising exploration holes Appointments that need to be concealed will be checked. In addition, the rationale of shredding facilities at the grid is also discussed in full. In this paper, the communication of electric vehicles with the shiny grid as a future energy framework model is discussed extensively using technology, and a research gap is discovered for potential arrangements.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment Analysis on Mobile Banking Using Cobit 5 Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: In general, public or private organizations or companies have used information-based technology as a support to improve business performance to be more effective and efficient in order to achieve a company's business goals. Banking companies include companies that use information technology such as Mobile Banking in their services. Mobile banking is a banking facility or service using mobile communication tools such as mobile phones, with the provision of facilities for banking transactions through mobile applications. Even though they have used a good SOP (Standard Operating Procedure), there are still many obstacles that occur, especially system problems and human errors. This can result in a high risk if it occurs continuously and will be fatal to the company's business processes. Therefore, COBIT 5 can be used as a benchmark for the IT assessment process on local bank mobile banking services. The purpose of the study is to determine the level of capability and strategy for improving risk management. The method used in this study is to focus on IT risk management with the COBIT 5 framework in the Evaluate Direct Monitoring (EDM) 3 domain, Align Plain Organize (APO) 12. From the results of the analysis, the calculation of the capability level is at Level 1 Performed Process with a score of 82.04%, thus the status has evidence as well as a systematic approach and this achievement is obtained significantly through the assessment of process attributes.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology Based Credibility Verification in E-Journal Entities
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: In the industrial era 4.0, it has surpassed increasingly complex technological advances in the information system that required a very high infrastructure and facilities and prevented fraud. Counterfeiting is a procedure following an entity, statistics, or documents (observe forged documents) with plans to deceive. Falsification of extensive information certificates is exacerbated by the current economic situation in Indonesia, which is currently occurring due to the widespread epidemic, namely COVID-19. The spread of the COVID-19 outbreak has had a significant impact and changes in all sectors, especially certificate forgery in Indonesia. The imitation of busy certificates is the main focus of this journal, focusing on journal publications combined with Blockchain technology. The sophistication of blockchain technology as authentication is comparing two or more items or additional tests to ensure the accuracy, correctness, or correctness of the information. This method uses qualitative methods with data sources based on case studies in controlled supervision with the basic concept of cryptography as the basis of analysis. From the decisions made, it is hoped that this will minimize the level of forgery of certificates widely measured during the COVID-19 era.

articleTitle: The University's Integrated ICT Infrastructure: UTAUT2 Implementation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Post-pandemic and globalization have accelerated the implementation of Industry 4.0, aided by rapid technological and information advancements. Industry 4.0 has significant consequences for all institutions in developing ICT infrastructure, one of which is educational institutions. Despite the enthusiasm in all educational institutions for using ICT to improve teaching and learning, particularly in universities, integrating technology is becoming problematic. Integrating ICT infrastructure in universities is a multidimensional process involving technology and curriculum, pedagogy, institutional readiness, lecturer competence, and long-term financial planning. Because of this, it is essential to explain the adoption of technology within the scope of this study to make the most of investments made in the integrated ICT infrastructure of the university using the UTAUT2 method.

articleTitle: The Role of Digital Technologies in Incorporating Neoliberal Principles Into Higher Education in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: National strategies have been critical in defining how digital technologies are used in higher education (HE). This study draws on some analyses of digital teaching and learning strategies released by the Indonesian government. It exemplifies that, across the strategies, digital technologies are portrayed as instruments for progressing neoliberal principles in Indonesian higher education. Paradoxically, the strategies are also riddled with inconsistencies and ambiguity regarding the asserted connections between digital technologies, learning, and markets. This problematic portrayal of digital technologies makes them complicit in the neoliberal erosion of Indonesian HE. This study contends that the problematic representation of digital technologies contributes to their involvement in the neoliberal erosion of Indonesian HE.

articleTitle: FAST-Based Production Monitoring Information System for Extra-High Voltage Power Line Towers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The role of computers is indispensable in various aspects of life, especially in the Production Monitoring information system which increases work productivity. PT Citra Banjar Abadi is a company that produces iron and steel electric towers for the needs of making High Voltage Power Line Towers, where this research takes place. The problem that occurs at this time is that the steel production monitoring information system is not optimal because it still uses a manual system so that there are often problems, one of which is the problem of production progress that cannot be monitored properly so that the completion of production is not on time. The purpose of this study is to provide solutions to problems that occur using the FAST (Framework Analytical System Thinking) method. The result of this research is to produce a steel production monitoring information system for the Tower Extra High Voltage Power Line for PT Citra Banjar Abadi, Indonesia.

articleTitle: Implementation of E-Planning System for Preparation of Work Plans among Local Government in Indonesian 3T Regions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Implementation of E-Planning in Indonesia used for the preparation of work plans. Likewise, in frontier regions (3T), its implemented in all of the local governments in Indonesia. Many studies on E-Planning were found in the literature to make work plans more effective. There are limited studies to develop E-Planning implementation among frontier regions of Local Government (3T). The novelty of this research is to help frontier regions implement the e-planning system for local Government in frontier regions. This study aims to understand the implementation of the E-Planning system for work preparation among frontier regions of Local Government (3T) in Indonesia. This study uses data collected from BAPPEDA as a state planning agency in local Government to explore the implementation of e-planning among frontier regions (3T) of Local Government. The outcome of the implementation of E-planning shows that the communication and coordination among center agency planners of local Government to each head department to make work plan by intensive accompanied.

articleTitle: Door Lock Access Control using Fusion of Face and Fingerprint Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This paper proposes an application of biometric- based fusion for doorlock access to improve room security. Generally, using a biometric system, door lock access technology still uses a unimodal approach. Some products are pretty good, but the gap for improvement is still open for further development. A fusion approach can be used to create a multimodal biometric system to deal with the progress. In this research, we propose combining facial and fingerprint recognition technologies to increase the security of the system. At the score level, we used a combination of two access technologies based on multimodal bio-metrics. Face modalities were captured with a webcam camera, the haar-cascade technique was used to detect them, and the CNN dlib method was used to recognize them. The FPM10A sensor was used to capture the fingerprint modality, the characteristics were extracted using the KAZE method, and the matching was done using the Brute-Force algorithm. A comparison of the False Acceptance Rate (FAR) and False Rejection Rate (FRR) between the unimodal and multimodal biometric systems was performed to evaluate the performance of the multimodal biometric system. The resulting FAR is 10%, with an FRR of 11% and a Genuine Acceptance Rate (GAR) of 90%, according to our experiments. Thus, the system that we have created and developed is quite capable of being used as an alternative door lock access method in addition to other types of door locks.

articleTitle: Digital Dashboard for College Management Business Intelligence Analysis with ROI Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Many tertiary institutions have diverse but not integrated data sources, causing information overload. This is where we need to use the Digital Dashboard which can be applied to Higher Education management. This research will take place in the Raharja College located in the city of Tangerang-Indonesia. Digital Dashboard is needed due to problems that occur at this time in several universities, such as the absence of a system of measuring the performance of staff at universities, the need for management to get fast and accurate information in decision making, the absence of clear and integrated data management for information to be made, as well as flexible field conditions and loaded with data uncertainty, so that many intangible measures will be found. The purpose of this study is to identify the benefits achieved and carry out the process of quantification of these benefits to measure their economic value, conduct a study of the ability of the Digital Dashboard to support the performance of management and staff of Higher Education to then be developed into a real application, Generate a prototype of Digital Dashboard which is equipped with Business Intelligence which can ultimately help provide online/real time services as a reference for decision making. The method used in this research is to use the Simple-ROI calculation method of tangible benefits and the calculation of Quasi intangible benefits that can be achieved (Value Linking and Value Acceleration). This research produces a proposal that can be used as a justification as well as an illustration of the possibility of implementing and developing a Digital Dashboard system at the College of Raharja.

articleTitle: Improved Intrusion Detection System (IDS) performance using Machine Learning: A Comparative Study of Single Classifier and Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Unlike conventional firewalls, intrusion detection systems (IDS) are acknowledged as a very significant and leading strategy for detecting hazardous behaviors on computer networks, and they are rapidly replacing them. Unlike traditional firewalls, IDS employs analytical methodology such as data mining and machine learning techniques to intelligently identify threats, whereas traditional firewalls do not. Ensemble learning has spurred progress in machine learning and pattern classification research in recent decades, with results that surpass single classifiers. Research was carried as part of this study to improve the accuracy rate of an intrusion detection system. To evaluate which technique worked best, a singular classifier was used to identify given data in order to obtain the highly accurate results, which were then evaluated to the findings of ensemble learning and feature selection. Using ensemble learning, the goal is to obtain the most accuracy out of a single classifier. The results are produced from the confusion matrix value, and they will be evaluated through making a comparison acquired using the two different methods stated above. The researchers were able to get an accuracy score of 77.4% for a single classifier and 96.8% for ensemble learning.

articleTitle: CS-SCHT Sequences for Asynchronous Multicarrier Communications System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: In this paper, we derive the bit-error rate (BER) expression for asynchronous multicarrier communications systems using complex sequences over Rician fading channels. Simultaneously, we evaluate the BER performance of conjugate symmetric sequency-ordered complex Hadamard transform (CS-SCHT) sequences with Walsh-Hadamard transform (WHT), sequency-ordered complex Hadamard transform (SCHT) sequences, and half-spectrum property unified complex Hadamard transform (HSP-UCHT) under the system. The numerical simulations are implemented and the results show that CS-SCHT outperform other three sequences in the presence of multiple access interference (MAI) and the additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN).

Author Keywords: conjugate symmetric sequency-ordered complex Hadamard transform (CS-SCHT)

articleTitle: Developing Dataset of Response Variance for Automatic English Speaking Testing App
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Through student speeches and other means, English teachers have already been able to assess their students' speaking skills firsthand. A huge number of pupils' speaking skills must be evaluated, which takes time. Thus, the need for an automated methodology to gauge English-speaking proficiency. It is good to examine English speaking with a computer using speech recognition technologies. However, to accurately assess the students' speaking performance automatically using computer requires a large dataset of students' various responses that are marked as appropriate responses. These responses are further marked as correct or expected responses, which later be used for automatic scoring generation and other various useful features. In this research we develop a dataset by collecting, analysing, categorising, and weighting various answer possibilities collected from students' responses to specific questions. The dataset, from 20 participants, was examined through Confusion Matrix, and it yielded accuracy score above 80%. However, this yielding result needs further testing with higher number of participants to get stronger accuracy. This dataset is expected to power the automatic English speaking testing app in assessing students' speaking performance. Eventually, the app is expected to be helpful for English teachers to efficiently score the speaking performance of huge numbers of students.

articleTitle: New Business Search Model using Patent Landscape in Japan
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: In recent years, intellectual property departments in Japanese companies have been required to analyze patent information to propose new businesses to management and business unit managers that can capitalize on their company’s strengths. A model (Mirror method) was proposed in a previous study to search for new businesses suitable for the company by analyzing patent information, beginning with the company’s strengths. In a previous study, it was reported that the Miller method can be used as a pilot study to search the cosmetics business, a new business of Fujifilm in the 2000s, but this is the only case where the method was used, and the effectiveness of the Miller method has not been verified for other industries, products, or periods. Therefore, in this study, we used the Miller method on a different case than in previous studies to verify if the method is effective. Specifically, we took on the AminoIndex business, which evaluates disease risk from blood samples, which was launched by Ajinomoto Co. in the 2010s. It was confirmed as a result of the verification that the Miller method can be used to extract business related to investigation and analysis of biological materials such as blood and urine using chromatographic methods, which includes Ajinomoto’s new business in the 2010s, screening disease risk from blood.

articleTitle: Processing Near-Infrared Spectroscopy Signal to Calculate Soil Macronutrient: A Comparison of Some Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Plantation plants need macronutrients Nitrogen (N), Phosphor (P), and Potassium (K) in the right amount during its growth period to grow optimally. Nowadays, the methods to measure soil macronutrient is still a relatively long time method, whereas it needs to be done as soon as possible. The rapid prediction system of the soil macronutrinet measurement is needed. The rapid prediction system requires the model of low energy consumption to apply on the portable mini computer. Most of the current researchs produce the model which requires the high energy consumption. This study aims to compare the performance of several machine learning (ML) algorithms in processing near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) signals with the application of several preprocessing techniques to get the best one to perform in the rapid predicition system to produce the low energy consumption model. Spectrum data is preprocessed using a random over-sampling technique and principal component analysis (PCA) of four number of principle components (PCs), 3, 5, 7, and 10. The training process of the model was conducted by four algorithms: random forest (RF), gradient boosting (GB), deep neural network (DNN), and partial least square (PLS). Prediction models on the N-P-K content data in mineral soils have been made, and it is found that the RF 10-PC algorithm is the most optimal for N with values of R<sup>2</sup>, RMSE, MAPE, NSE and Accuracy of 0.661, respectively; 0.022; 8,123; 0.667 and 91.88%. The RF 10-PC algorithm is the most optimal for P with evaluation parameters of 0.705; 9.250; 20.640; 0.806; and 79.36%. Also, the GB 3-PC algorithm is the most optimal for K with evaluation parameters of 0.774; 6.711; 10.307; 0.772, and 89.96%, respectively. This research found the low energy consumption model. PCA extract the features and also decrease the total of input variables from 131 to 10-PC and 3-PC of the model in order to decrease the model energy consumption.

articleTitle: The Assessment of Human Development Index in West Java Province of Indonesia Using Regression and R Programming Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The effectiveness of economic development in developing countries is often only judged on an economic basis, even though it cannot be denied that improving the quality of human resources is also a sign of the success of economic development in a region. This study aims to determine and examine the variables that affect the HDI of West Java Province. We compared the two methods, Ordinary Least-Squares (OLS) and Weighted Geographic Regression (GWR), to represent non-spatial and spatial approaches. Twenty-seven districts in West Java Province in Indonesia were considered based on the Indonesian Central Statistics Agency dataset. The method used in this research is dataset analysis sourced from the website of the Central Statistics Agency (BPS). Six quantitative factors related to HDI were evaluated: life expectancy, expected length of education, the average length of education, per capita expenditure, number of the public health center, and open unemployment rate. The results of this study indicate that the variables of life expectancy, length of education, the average length of education, and expenditure per capita are four variables that have a significant effect on HDI figures in West Java, where GWR performs better than the OLS technology with a coefficient of determination (R2) and AIC value of 99.24113% and 35.10531. Further research is further developed by using robust regression to address outliers in several locations and adopting important factors that influence local policies on local policies.

articleTitle: Integrating Blockchain for Renewable Energy in Digital Business Era
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: In the current era of digitalization, intelligent systems resulting from the rapid development of technologies such as Information Technology (IT) and Information Communication Technology (ICT) play an essential role in carrying out strong collaboration on a system and have been used in many industries in the energy production sector, agriculture, building and other sectors. This rapid technological development has aroused the author’s body to conduct research in the realm of Renewable Energy, which is currently still a hot topic of controversy being discussed. New and renewable energies are considered a realistic alternative to fossil fuels, which have been integral to modern industry but are considered to cause environmental or economic problems, not to mention their limited reserves. Therefore, as renewable energy will gradually replace existing energy sources but will take more time to become fully available, it is essential to find a method of managing it fairly and transparently. From the background of these existing problems, the researcher will contribute a novelty of an efficient Blockchain-based consensus algorithm for the system. The finding of this research is the design of a Blockchain-based model to validate its parallel computing capabilities through simulation.

articleTitle: Single and Multi-Documents Text Summarization Technologies for Natural Language Processing: a Systematic Review on Method and Dataset
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The summarization technologies have been increasingly used in recent decades. Those technologies are a very important part of emerging topics in computer science and engineering, such that Natural Language Processing (NLP). Several methods have been used for analysis to get good summary results. There are two types of document summaries: single document summaries and multi-document summaries. Single document summaries aim to extract information from a single document to get new and relevant summary information, while multi-document summaries extract information from multiple documents. This study focuses on the activities of the semantic literature in previous studies to obtain the basis of the widely used base methods and data sets used in this study. Data was collected from Scopus publication sources from 2019 until 2022 Q2 for analysis. Researchers use guidelines from the semantic literature method by using the basis of Kitchenham and Charters as a reference in its design. In this study, there were forty-eight articles obtained from the filtering results of several criteria used, including exclusion and quality assessment.

articleTitle: A Review on Feature Selection Approaches and Few Prominent Research Gaps for Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Creative Communication and Innovative Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This paper presents approaches used for image classification. Feature selection is an important task which reduces time complexity to a greater extent and yields better results. It focuses on selecting relevant features and excluding irrelevant features. Various methods have been studied for formulating this work and significant research gaps have been marked for the authors to work. Several research gaps and papers containing Evolutionary computation (EC), Information Gain binary Butterfly Optimization Algorithm (IG-bBOA), Multi-objective genetic algorithm (MOGA), mRMJR-KCCA, MI based hybrid model, MI-SNN and MI-DNN are studied for formalizing this work. Feature selection problem for early time series classification and ethno botanical study on medicinal plants are also taken into consideration. Research gaps are framed based on extensive studies of literature. Research answers from literature and future directions are identified.
